title: HSBC rolls out Model ML globally
summary: HSBC partners with Model ML to support AI adoption across the bank, helping teams speed up research, analysis and content drafting in HSBC formats.
body_markdown:
Model ML today announced that HSBC has partnered with Model ML to help support adoption of AI across the bank.


Teams are using Model ML to assist with research and analysis and to help draft content in HSBC formats and templates. The underlying approach can be configured for different desks, helping colleagues apply AI in a way that fits existing workflows.


We’re pleased to be working with HSBC as it uses AI to drive efficiency and improve the quality and speed of insights and content.
